args.body: Problem with the 2026-10-14 3% increase. A catalog check shows 22 FIXED-PRICE CONTRACT products (P-1201 to P-1222) were increased 3%, though they were meant to be excluded. Since then, 8 orders (SO-77310 to SO-77317) were placed at the increased prices, with a total overcharge of 4,128.60. I applied the increase, so I'm treating this as my error. I have not yet changed any prices. Proposed fix: (1) revert P-1201 to P-1222 to their pre-increase prices. I'll do this on your OK, and I'll confirm the original prices from history first. (2) Have sales ops or finance correct or credit the 8 affected orders. Please confirm the revert.
